_about: Control protocol for the QCY-built SOUNDPEATS Capsule3 Pro (firmware codes QCYTS04 and SPTS04). Read from QCY's library inside PeatsAudio 1.9.45 and from how the app calls it. Not confirmed on hardware. See docs/PROTOCOL.md section 10. Hex strings are bytes in wire order.

settings.use: read or notify: an item packet with the current settings

battery.use: read: three bytes, left, right, case

transport.notify: Enable notifications on every characteristic of the service that offers them.

advertisement.battery: bytes 5, 6, 7: left, right, case. Bit 7 is charging, low 7 bits are percent.
advertisement.note: The app scans, reads the classic address out of the advertisement and connects to the device whose address matches the paired earbuds.

layout: length of everything after this byte
packet.note: Used on the command and settings characteristics. Several items can share one packet.

items.name: noise_value
items.note: One byte. The app ignores it.

items.name: game_mode
items.note: QCY calls it low latency. In reports, 01 is on and anything else is off.

items.name: touch_disabled
items.note: QCY calls it sleep mode. In reports, 01 is on and anything else is off.

items.name: multipoint
items.note: The app treats multipoint and LDAC as exclusive: turning multipoint on first sends ldac off, and turning it off first sends ldac on.

items.name: pair_name
items.note: The Bluetooth name. The app never sets it.

items.name: bt_info
items.note: Connected-device address. The app only logs it.

items.name: request
items.note: Value is one item id. Asks the earbuds to report that item. The app uses FE 01 24 to read multipoint.

battery: Three bytes: left, right, case. Bit 7 is charging, low 7 bits are percent.

buttons.format: Pairs of [gesture, function] with no FF header. A write can carry one pair or several. A read returns every pair.

format: master gain in dB x 100 (s16, little-endian)
then per band: frequency in Hz (u16 LE), gain in dB x 100 (s16 LE), Q x 100 (u16 LE)
eq.note: One write carries every band. No FF header. The official app truncates the master gain to a whole number of dB before scaling. A read whose first byte is 00 has the same layout; any other first byte is a QCY preset record the app ignores.

not_available_note: Command ids from data/commands.json that the app's Capsule3 Pro code leaves empty. ldac is in the list because the app's LDAC switch does nothing here: LDAC only changes as a side effect of multipoint.
